title: Side mirrors and side-window visibility
summary: This topic mainly groups side-mirror, side-window, and other side-related comments, with clear negatives centered on visibility reflections, moisture, and feature disappointments but many fragments too vague or mixed in subject to resolve sentiment confidently.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited to a brief remark that the car's mechanical side is good.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on mirror and side-window visibility problems at night, driver-side damp or condensation, and disappointment with side-mirror-related paid features.

undetermined.summary: Many fragments mention the side mirror, software side, ambient lights, or side windows without enough context to determine a clear sentiment, and some appear to mix unrelated side-related subjects.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence in a tighter summary.
